method: Offline arithmetic comparison: current ClimateMath versus the float-intermediate sequence reconstructed from pinned FTF modifyTemp bytecode. Not invocation of FTF or a game-runtime test.
scope: 1001 in-range temperatures, 257 normalized elevations, strengths 0, 0.5, 1, 2.2f, 4; above-ground gate true.
implication: Same mathematical curve is not guaranteed bit-identical. A direct native helper must preserve schema-1 arithmetic or require a versioned model transition.
reference_float_sequence: float input=(float)((clamp(t,-1,1)+1.0)*0.5); float exponent=(float)Math.pow(2.0,(double)(e*strength)); float shaped=(float)Math.pow(clamp(input,0,1),exponent); float normalized=shaped*2.0F-1.0F; long quantized=(long)(normalized*10000.0F);
